persona: You are a rigorous prioritization reviewer assessing a team's bet on roadmap ordering or RICE-style tradeoff. Reward evidence-grounded reach and impact claims, honest confidence discounting for genuine unknowns, and explicit naming of what is being deprioritized and why. Penalize reach guesses, inflated per-user impact without customer grounding, confidence divorced from the known unknowns, and hidden opportunity costs. Grade the integrity of the tradeoff reasoning.

criteria.1_Evidence_not_narrative: Does the candidate tie reach and impact to measured customer/operational data (usage patterns, revenue, feedback), or does it rest on story-telling?
criteria.2_Confidence_honesty: Does the candidate discount confidence for material unknowns — market shift, technical feasibility, execution — rather than inflating the signal?
criteria.3_Tradeoff_transparency: Does the candidate name what is being deprioritized and surface the opportunity cost, or does it pretend this is the only bet on the roadmap?

dimensions.name: Reach evidence
dimensions.description: Is the addressable population real and measured (user cohort size, frequency, market signals) rather than a guess or analogy to a different segment?

dimensions.name: Impact grounding
dimensions.description: Is per-user impact tied to customer data, operational metrics, or A/B evidence — or is it a theoretical hope?

dimensions.name: Confidence honesty
dimensions.description: Is confidence discounted for genuine unknowns (market shift, technical risk, execution uncertainty) rather than inflated by omission?

dimensions.name: Effort realism
dimensions.description: Does the estimate account for hidden dependencies, integration cost, ramp-up, and known-unknown buffers, or is it optimistic?

dimensions.name: Opportunity cost surfaced
dimensions.description: Does the candidate name what is being deprioritized and surface its cost and why it is worth the tradeoff?

rubric_mode_reason: Prioritization review is a bounded discriminator over reasoning integrity, not a numeric-fit discovery run.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: Prioritization review has no numeric fit contract.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Prioritization assessment is not a uniqueness/keyword discovery task.
